verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official JavaScript SDK for tracking events and sending them to destinations, with on-demand feature plugins. It also positions SDK instrumentation as its core developer workflow ("Instrument one RudderStack SDK...") and backs it with HTTP and management APIs. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond JavaScript (server-side or mobile languages), SDKs for the management APIs, and independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.
